name: Nanaogi Kyouka
source:
One of Ryou’s classmates.

Carefree and confident, she always lives life at her own pace.

She’s a model on the side while attending school, but she’s currently on break from work.

She knew Izumi since before attending Oumidai Academy and fought the Light Hunters alongside her.

Her ability is Satori, the power to read minds.

Her weapon is a snakedragon named Chiro.

(from Kagura Games' store)
